init.title: Latter System Options
init.description: Configure shared System entities and BLE roaming dwell behavior. For full system, area, and per-device controls, open the Latter Studio from the Home Assistant sidebar.

confirm.title: Update mapped entities for {device_slug}
confirm.description: The following entities mapped to **{device_slug}** could not be found in Home Assistant: **{missing_list}**. Open the Latter Studio to select replacement entities, then confirm below to clear this warning.

ble_no_proxies.title: No Area-assigned Bluetooth proxies found for {device_slug}

confirm.title: Assign Bluetooth proxies to Home Assistant Areas
confirm.description: Built-in BLE Area Tracking is enabled for **{device_slug}**, but no Bluetooth scanner proxies assigned to a Home Assistant Area were detected. Assign your ESPHome BLE proxies to their corresponding Areas in Home Assistant, or disable BLE tracking if stationary.

confirm.title: Verify ESPHome connection and firmware for {device_slug}
confirm.description: Latter failed to push browse or area slots to **{device_slug}** 5 consecutive times ({service_name}: {error}). Verify that the ESPHome device is online and running matching Protocol v3 firmware.

link_ma_player.title: Pick the Music Assistant player for {device_slug}

pick.title: Link {device_slug} to its Music Assistant player
pick.description: Music Assistant doesn't report this device's MAC address or device, so Latter can't find the Music Assistant player behind **{speaker_entity}** on its own. Pick **{device_slug}**'s player once. Library playback, queues and lyrics on the device use it. You can change it later in Latter Studio (device → Sound & Media Player).

abort.device_removed: This device is no longer part of Latter.

error.invalid_ma_player: Pick a Music Assistant media player.

confirm.title: {device} crashed
confirm.description: **{device}** reported a crash reset (**{reason}**) when it booted at {time} (Latter SDK rev {sdk}). Open the device's logs in ESPHome Device Builder before it restarts again: the decoded backtrace is shown there. Decoding needs the build the device is running. Confirm to dismiss; a new crash raises this again.

confirm.title: {device} lost power briefly
confirm.description: **{device}** reported a brownout reset when it booted at {time} (Latter SDK rev {sdk}): its supply voltage sagged below the safe level. Check the power supply, the USB cable, or the battery. Confirm to dismiss; a new brownout raises this again.

confirm.title: {device} rolled back its firmware
confirm.description: The last firmware update on **{device}** failed to boot, so the device went back to the previous firmware (Latter SDK rev {sdk}, reported at {time}). Check the build logs, then install the update again. This clears after a successful update.

explicit_action_required.message: Lock and alarm actions require an explicit command (lock, unlock, open, arm_home, arm_away, arm_night, or disarm); toggle is not permitted.

ma_counterpart_required.message: Music Assistant counterpart player is required to play library media on {speaker}.

not_supported.message: The requested action is not supported by this entity.

unknown_target.message: Target Latter device {target_device} could not be resolved.
